name: Ignis
source: A general of the military nation Daigroth and a beautiful woman known across Ortesia for her skill with a giant scythe. Belligerent, she mercilessly swings her blade against enemies, but shows deep affection to those she trusts. Although she speaks harshly to Lan, it is out of a desire to see Lan grow.
